references.text: The warning about forgetting the Lord when one becomes full and lives in good houses, the same theme of wealth leading to spiritual forgetfulness
The preceding verse describing fullness and blessing from the Lord, direct context for the warning
Continuation of the warning that the heart may become proud as wealth increases
A similar warning to be on guard when one eats and becomes full
Jeshurun grew fat and kicked, a prophetic fulfillment of the warning about wealth leading to apostasy
The wisdom in Proverbs about not asking for riches to avoid becoming full and denying the Lord
Hosea describes the same pattern: they became full and their hearts grew proud, and they forgot the Lord
Nehemiah describes how the people ate, became full, and enjoyed God's gifts, yet became disobedient
